name: How much does a kitchen renovation typically cost in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen renovation typically cost in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen renovation costs in Las Vegas vary widely based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the size of your kitchen. A minor refresh might start from $15,000, while a mid-range remodel could range from $30,000 to $70,000. High-end custom renovations with premium materials and significant layout changes can exceed $100,000. Factors like new cabinetry, countertops, appliances, flooring, and plumbing or electrical reconfigurations all impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen renovation costs in Las Vegas vary greatly, from $15,000 for minor updates to over $100,000 for high-end projects, depending on materials and scope.
